caption: The drawing depicts two views of a single upholstered armchair rendered in black ink lines on a beige background. On the left side is a front view, vertically divided by a dashed line at its center; the right half of this front view is shaded in gray while the left half is unshaded. The backrest and seat are shown with defined, curved outlines and moldings, and the armrest curves outward before swooping downward to connect to the stiles. The legs are cabriole style, terminating in small scroll feet. On the right side of the drawing is a profile (side) view of the same chair, showing the armrest curving down to the seat and further illustrating the backward tilt and contour of the tall chair back. The seat and the inside area of the backrest are both shaded in gray, while the rest of the outline remains unshaded. The lower right of the drawing contains a scale annotation reading "Scale: 2" = 1'-0"." There are no additional objects, and the background is empty apart from faint discoloration near the edges.
title: Chair
